sn14.22:1.6: āraddhaviriyā āraddhaviriyehi saddhiṃ …pe… upaṭṭhitasatino upaṭṭhitasatīhi saddhiṃ
sn14.22:1.7: …pe… paññavanto paññavantehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti. atītampi bhikkhave, addhānaṃ …pe… anāgatampi bhikkhave, addhānaṃ …pe… etarahipi bhikkhave, paccuppannaṃ addhānaṃ …pe… kusītā …pe… muṭṭhassatino …pe… duppaññā …pe… āraddhaviriyā …pe… upaṭṭhitasatino …pe… paññavanto paññavantehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samentīti. sattadhātuvaggo
